# Semgrep Gotchas

> Known Semgrep and Opengrep patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors, mostly around rule suppression.

## Entries

- [A nosemgrep comment above a JSX conditional wrapper suppresses nothing](nosemgrep-above-jsx-conditional-is-ignored.md): `nosemgrep` counts only on the finding's first line or the line directly above it, so a comment above `{cond && (` or a ternary is silently ignored and the finding stays open; put it directly above the element and above the prop line. HIGH.
